body:
While reviewing README.md, I noticed that the Creative Commons BY-SA 4.0 license reference uses HTTP:

- http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

The official HTTPS version is available and resolves correctly.

Proposed change:
- Update the link to HTTPS without modifying any surrounding content.

comments.body: Sorry for the delay here. It seems like a straightforward case. If you are interested, you can open a PR to fix it.

title: HTTP Creative Commons license link in README.md can be upgraded to HTTPS
